title: hubbus event (one row of .state/bus.db; bin/hubbus)
description: Append-only event log. payload is the object decoded from the JSON string and always carries "v": 1 (events before 2026-10-22 have none; read as 1). Any payload may carry chain (the scheduled jobs whose runs caused the event, oldest first) and depth (how many scheduled runs deep it is): docs/design/event-jobs.md section 7. Adding a field keeps the version; renaming/changing a meaning bumps it, with both versions side by side. message.routed: one session holds this request or question (payload session, by: only|thread|model|recent|hook), or the route ended (session null, ended: why); ids are unique per row and the latest row by seq is the state (docs/design/mailbox-session-first.md). message.passed: the session it was routed to gave it back (payload session), and its route ended with it (ended: passed). message.delivered's via: session-start, prompt, post-tool, inbox (told), ack, resume (a fork), triage (a headless agent went, not taken), held (the platform starts nothing more, not taken), handler (from before triage: taken for good).

id.description: unique id given by the sender; resending the same id = does nothing

source.description: sender address: a project name, the platform, or owner (or the owner's configured alias)

to_project.description: the recipient address of a message

ref.description: which event this event is about (delivered/routed/done → the letter id; reply → the original letter)

record.description: one Principal Handoff 0.3 record (written by hubbus record-publish, exchanged with the assistant by bridge v2; event id = rec:<ext>:<project>:<record id>; the same record id with other content, core §10, is stored beside it as that event id + ~<16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 form>). The record's full format follows the agent-ops-specs core/acts/decisions schemas and is validated before it is written to the bus; here only the envelope is checked

config_applied.description: bin/hub config apply applied a version of the config (docs/design/new-user.md 3.7): commit = the commit that last changed the config files, changes = the changes each applier actually made

outbox_refused.description: a notice from agent-hub: this file in the project's outbox was refused and deleted (docs/design/bus-sender.md)
